subject: Multi-site private deployment — license split & support credits
messages:
From: Sylvia Cho <sylvia.cho@novushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Novus multi-site deployment — initial ask

Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Novus has committed to a 3-site pilot (east, midwest, west) with potential roll-out to ~18 sites by Q4. Procurement asked me to get written confirmation on a few commercial points before we proceed to SOW:

- Can Redwood amortize the platform fee across the pilot (3 sites) with an optional stagger for expansion?
- We need an approach to support credits in case the pilot misses agreed availability targets; can you propose a simple credit matrix?
- For on-prem installs, can you confirm per-site license vs. centralized license (we'd prefer centralized but some of our security folks insist on per-site entitlements) and the delta in pricing?

I've attached a draft SOW (high level) and a spreadsheet with estimated capacity. Ideally we'd have a short term sheet to present to Finance by end of next week.

Thanks,

Sylvia Cho
Head of AI Programs
Novus Health
--
Attachment: Novus_SOW_v1.pdf (attachment stub)
Attachment: novus-capacity-estimates.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Cho <sylvia.cho@novushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus multi-site deployment — initial ask

Sylvia —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

- Platform fee amortization: Yes — we can amortize the platform fee across the pilot sites for Year 1, with an expansion trigger to re-price at >6 sites.
- Support credits: we can offer a simple SLA credit ladder tied to monthly availability and P1 response SLAs.
- Licensing model: centralized entitlement (single license, multi-site) is the default and cheaper; per-site entitlements are possible but carry a ~12% premium (covers additional per-site packaging and ops).

I'll outline a counter-proposal in the attached pricing workbook and a 1-page commercial term sheet for Finance. Vanessa, can you add an option that amortizes the platform fee across pilot and shows incremental price if they insist on per-site entitlements? Rishi — can you validate the P1/P2 target language we should use for the credit matrix? Neha — I'll want your procurement checklist included for the SOW.

Proposed next step: short call Thursday (30 minutes) to agree terms so we can get a signed LOI.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-multisite-pricing-model.xlsx (attachment stub), redwood-commercial-term-sheet-1p.pdf (attachment stub)

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus multi-site deployment — initial ask

Sylvia / team —

FW — quick technical note on the SLA credit ladder. For a multi-site private deployment we should clearly separate:

1) Redwood-hosted control plane outage (rare) — credit applies platform-wide.
2) Per-site operational degradation due to customer network/on-prem infra — credit only for that site unless it affects routing/replication across the cluster.

Suggested thresholds (draft):
- Monthly availability < 99.5%: 10% support credit for affected month
- Monthly availability < 98.0%: 25% support credit + one-time remediation engineering credit (capped)
- P1 missed SLA (24x7 respond within 1 hour) — 15% credit if response > 4 hours

I'll add a brief note in the SOW about remediation runbooks and the escalation path (oncall rotation + dedicated CSM for pilot).

—Rishi

To: Sylvia Cho <sylvia.cho@novushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial options and a simplified two-line offer

Sylvia —

Following up from our internal align: to keep Finance happy, here's a simplified two-line commercial option we can put on the table quickly:

Option A (Centralized pilot) — Year 1 pilot (3 sites):
- Annual platform fee: $120k (amortized across 3 sites = $40k/site)
- Per-site license: $18k/site/year (centralized entitlements; includes KV cache limits specified)
- Support: Standard (business hours) included; 24x7 oncall add-on at +$22k/year
- SLA credit ladder as Rishi proposed

Option B (Per-site entitlements) — Year 1 pilot (3 sites):
- Annual platform fee: $120k (no amortization concession)
- Per-site license: $20.2k/site/year (~12% premium)
- Support: Standard included; 24x7 oncall add-on at +$22k/year

Tradeoffs to highlight for Novus: centralized reduces ops overhead and simplifies upgrades; per-site eases compliance but increases unit cost.

If that looks acceptable we can produce a 1-page LOI and a short SOW. Sylvia — what is your Finance deadline? We can flex timing for invoicing (net 30 vs net 45) if that helps close this pilot.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Commercial Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-two-line-offer.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Sylvia Cho <sylvia.cho@novushealth.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-site private deployment — license split & support credits

Vanessa/Marissa —

Thanks — this is exactly what Finance needed. A couple quick clarifications before we take to the CFO:

- Can the platform fee be invoiced as two equal installments (pilot start + 90 days) for cashflow smoothing?
- We accept the centralized pilot pricing but will request per-site entitlements for three particular hospitals that are in highly regulated programs; please convert those 3 sites to per-site pricing in the SOW (we expect the delta but want it documented).
- For the SLA credits, can you add an explicit cap on cumulative credits per 12-month period (e.g., max 50% of annual support fees)?

If you can get a redlined 1-page LOI and an updated SOW with the three mixed-entitlement lines, we should be able to route to CFO this week. Also please include a DocuSign link for the LOI to speed approvals.

I'll loop procurement if anything bigger than net 45 is needed.

Best,

Sylvia Cho
Head of AI Programs
Novus Health
